credit.credit-words: Już tam ojciec do swej Basi
So long as we still live.
What the foreign force has taken from us,
From the Italian land to Poland.
We'll cross the Vistula, we'll cross the Warta,
Bonaparte has given us the example
We shall return across the sea.
this arrangement i've made is for a Band-like formation... there is one Piccolo, two flutes, one clarinet
two alto sax, one tenor sax and one bariton, also there are part for drums, timpani and cymbals. Hope you enjoy!
P.S. the parts can be played by more instruments at the same time.
